# PRJNA291919 — cereal field RNA-seq cohort evidence

## setting
**94 run(s)** — rule `dan19c-setting` — 10.1002/pld3.129  
*Materials and methods, 'Experimental design and drought stress management in the field at Woodland, CA'; corroborated by the GEO growth protocol on all 94 samples*

> The initial drought field experiment was conducted in Woodland, CA (38 40'N, 121 50'W) during the summer of 2012. This location typically has no rainfall during the growing season and precision irrigation is provided via sub surface drip tapes. B73 seeds were planted in 4-row plots in a randomized complete block design with four replications. The length of the plot was 4.4 m, 29 plants per plot. | Well-watered (WW) plots were fully irrigated throughout the entire growth cycle of the crop. In contrast, plots that were designated to receive the drought treatment (DRT) were fully irrigated until plants reached the V7-V8 stage, when irrigation was terminated. | GEO growth_protocol_ch1, identical on all 94 samples: 'B73 maize plants were grown in a field in Woodland, CA in 2012.'
